name: action-browser
description: Open pages, inspect them, and capture screenshots in a real background Chrome session.

interface.shortDescription: Real Chrome screenshots and simple browser actions
interface.longDescription: Action Browser gives agents a small browser-use surface backed by a real, isolated Chrome profile. Open a page without stealing focus, inspect its interactive elements, click or fill a field, and receive a PNG screenshot directly in the tool result.
defaultPrompt: Open example.com in Chrome and show me a screenshot
Inspect the current page and list its interactive elements
Open my local site and capture a full-page screenshot
